name: csrms-iot
description: Wokwi ESP32 simulations for the CSRMS sensors. Requires the wokwi-cli binary on PATH (https://docs.wokwi.com/wokwi-ci/cli-installation) and PlatformIO Core for compiling.

scripts.lint: wokwi-cli lint network-monitor && wokwi-cli lint water-leak-sensor && wokwi-cli lint fire-smoke-sensor
scripts.compile: pio run -d network-monitor && pio run -d water-leak-sensor && pio run -d fire-smoke-sensor
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run compile && npm run test:network && npm run test:water && npm run test:fire
